blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation between Nîmes and the western Rhône delta, in the Gard. Its wines resemble Rhône wines more than Languedoc ones, and it is now run by the Rhône wine committee. Its main allowed grapes are Mourvèdre, Syrah, Grenache, Marsanne and Roussanne.
